Comment: The warmup of every run that starts on 4 nodes on the Wikipedia c1024 index with RNG-pruned replicas (the SPFresh example: fusion_build --from-index the base index --rng, 6.71 replicas a vector against the base's 7.27; the base's IDs, raw-vector locations, codebook and page file), its 64 GP partitions made as the base's (results/rng-index-2026-11-23/after-build.sh): deploys them and saves the snapshot of their raw vectors and PQ codes those runs then start on (scripts/run_local.py, type: warmup), on the lab server, from the page file, on the CPU backend; as experiment.wiki-c1024-warmup-4.json otherwise. A cluster's hosts get the index and partition files copied, and each initial node's part of the snapshot under the same SnapshotDir.
